title: Rock&Roll Retreat Near Airport/Broadway
description:
Welcome to Heartbreak Hotel — a modern music-inspired condo designed for the perfect Nashville experience. Located just minutes from Broadway, BNA Airport, and the Grand Ole Opry, this stylish retreat combines comfort, convenience, and Nashville vibes.

The space
📍 Prime Location
• 10 mins to Broadway & Bridgestone Arena
• 12 mins to Nashville International Airport (BNA)
• 13 mins to Grand Ole Opry
• Quick access to restaurants, live music, and downtown attractions
✨ The Space
✔ Sleeps 4
✔ 1 Bedroom + Queen Sleeper Sofa
✔ Professionally designed interior
✔ Newly renovated with modern furniture
✔ Free secured parking
✔ High-speed Wi-Fi
✔ Keyless self check-in
✔ Washer & Dryer
🛋 Living Room
• Comfortable modern sleeper sofa
• 44” Roku Smart TV
• Unique Elvis mural painted by a local artist
🍳 Fully Equipped Kitchen
• Coffee bar with Keurig & French press
• Full-size refrigerator
• Dishwasher
• Electric oven & toaster
• Dining area + workspace
🛏 Bedroom Comforts
• Queen bed with premium Purple mattress
• Sound machine for restful sleep
• Walk-in closet
• Iron, ironing board & luggage rack
⭐ Perfect for couples, business travelers, weekend getaways, and music lovers looking to experience the best of Nashville.
Book your stay today and experience Music City in style!

Guest access
Enjoy a completely private and comfortable stay — no shared spaces and no disturbances.
Guests will receive a unique access code for easy self check-in and full private access to the entire condo during their stay.

Other things to note
🌟 Upon arrival, you will notice two condo buildings that look very similar. Our unit is located in Building 293. If you have any trouble finding it, feel free to contact us anytime — we’re always happy to help!
🌟 Cell phone service may vary depending on your carrier, but the condo includes reliable high-speed Wi-Fi for seamless streaming, working, and browsing.
🌟 Conveniently located just minutes from Downtown Nashville and the airport, making it easy to enjoy the city while still relaxing in a quiet and comfortable space.
